tasks.title: Conversation #21
tasks.transcript:
WOMAN: Did you see the list of activities taking place at the community center that was released today?
MAN: Not yet. Is there anything on there that looks interesting? I'd love to do some fun activities this summer.
WOMAN: I'm thinking of taking part in the fishing contest. Would you like to join me? We can be on the same team.
MAN: Okay, that sounds good to me. Do we have to pay a fee to enter?
WOMAN: I don't, because I'm a member of the community center, but since you don't belong to it, it will cost you $15 to enter.

questions.stem: Where will the events most likely take place?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这些活动最可能在哪里举行，属于推理判断题，需根据对话中的地点关键词进行推断。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 女士明确提到“the list of activities taking place at the community center”以及“I'm a member of the community center”，说明活动是在社区中心举行。 选项B：错误。 对话中提到钓鱼比赛，但并未说明在州立公园举行，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到大学校园，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到市中心区域，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: Why does the man have to pay a fee?

options.B: He is participating for the first time.
options.D: He did not pay at the last event he took part in.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士为什么要付费，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士解释收费原因的具体说明。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 女士明确说“I don't（pay）, because I'm a member of the community center, but since you don't belong to it, it will cost you $15 to enter.”，说明男士需要付费是因为他不是社区中心的会员。 选项B：错误。 对话中没有提到男士是否是第一次参加，属于无关信息。 选项C：错误。 女士作为会员不需要付费，说明并非所有参与者都要付费，与选项意思相反。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到男士上次参加活动时是否付费，属于无中生有。
